rows.what_the_ink_shows: The imaginary numerator is an unmistakable 24: curved-top 2 followed by the angular open 4 with a descending stem. Both fractions have denominator 25, and the first numerator reads 16. The 24 is unstruck. See crops/138_scan111_L406.jpg.
rows.note: Retain c=16/25 ± (24/25)i as written. The row’s 12/25 is a correction to the author’s arithmetic, not to the reading of the digits. No quadratic-formula calculation was independently performed.
